title: Naïve raises $28.5M to automate the grunt work of setting up and running a company | TechCrunch
summary: Dorje said proceeds from the Series A will be used to hire researchers and develop the company’s four infrastructure projects: virtualized sandboxes for agents; model routing and inference optimization; a memory layer; and governance and orchestration.
